HIGH COURTOF MANIPUR
The Schedule for the Written Examination and the Examination Centre shall be
indicated in the Admit Card, which may be downloaded from the official website
https://hcmimphal.nic.in from 18th July, 2026 (03:00 P.M.) onwards.
No. HCMEST/A-28/80-Estt.jVol-IV(pt.)/ 1'1<t9, : Pursuant to this Registry's
Advertisement of even number dated 29th September, 2022 and the subsequent
Notification of even number dated 8th March, 2024, regarding the filling of choices for
Examination Centres in connection with the recruitment to the 1 (one) vacant post of
Library Assistant in the High Court of Manipur, it is hereby informed to all concerned
that the Written Examination is scheduled to be held on 26th July, 2026 (Sunday).,
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 3(JhJune, 2026
